raw_findings.title: FTP service exposed (cleartext file transfer)
raw_findings.description: An FTP service accepted a TCP connection. Plain FTP transmits credentials and data without encryption.
raw_findings.remediation: Replace FTP with SFTP or FTPS and disable anonymous access unless explicitly required.
raw_findings.excerpt: 127.0.0.1:2121/tcp open service=ftp banner="220 LabFTP ready (anonymous allowed)"

raw_findings.title: Service banner discloses software details (ftp)
raw_findings.description: The service announces product/version information to unauthenticated clients, aiding attacker reconnaissance.
raw_findings.remediation: Suppress or genericise service banners where the product allows it.
raw_findings.excerpt: 127.0.0.1:2121/tcp open service=ftp banner="220 LabFTP ready (anonymous allowed)"

raw_findings.title: Telnet service exposed (cleartext remote administration)
raw_findings.description: A Telnet service accepted a TCP connection. Telnet transmits credentials and session data without encryption.
raw_findings.remediation: Disable Telnet and use SSH with key-based authentication. Restrict management ports to an admin network.

raw_findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
raw_findings.description: The response has no Content-Security-Policy, which weakens defence-in-depth against cross-site scripting and content injection.
raw_findings.remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (default-src 'self') and tighten it iteratively.
raw_findings.excerpt: GET http://127.0.0.1:8008 -> 200; response headers contain no "content-security-policy" header

raw_findings.title: Missing clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
raw_findings.description: Neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors directive is present, so the page can be framed by other origins.
raw_findings.remediation: Send 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' (or SAMEORIGIN) or a CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive.
raw_findings.excerpt: GET http://127.0.0.1:8008 -> 200; response headers contain no "x-frame-options" header

raw_findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
raw_findings.description: Responses lack 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff', allowing MIME sniffing in some browsers.
raw_findings.excerpt: GET http://127.0.0.1:8008 -> 200; response headers contain no "x-content-type-options" header

raw_findings.title: Web server discloses software/version in Server header
raw_findings.description: The Server header reveals product and version, helping attackers choose targeted exploits.
raw_findings.remediation: Remove or genericise the Server header (e.g. ServerTokens Prod / server_tokens off).

raw_findings.description: A page containing a password field is delivered over plain HTTP, so credentials can be intercepted on the network.
raw_findings.remediation: Serve all authenticated pages over HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

raw_findings.description: The /.git/ directory is reachable; source code and secrets may be reconstructable.
raw_findings.remediation: Block access to /.git/ at the web server and remove VCS metadata from deployed content.

raw_findings.description: An environment file is downloadable and typically holds credentials and API keys.
raw_findings.remediation: Remove .env from the web root and rotate every secret it contained.
